name: Jonas Andresen
title: IT Security & Systems Administrator
summary: IT Security professional with 13+ years of experience securing and administering enterprise environments across small-medium businesses and large corporate infrastructures. Hands-on expertise in endpoint detection and response (EDR), email security, cloud identity, and Microsoft 365 security administration. Proven track record of implementing and managing security tooling at scale while maintaining lean IT operations.

experience.title: Information Technology System Administrator
responsibilities: Administered and monitored CrowdStrike Falcon EDR across the organization, managing endpoint policy, alert triage, and threat response in an Oil and Gas engineering environment.
Managed Abnormal Security for Microsoft 365 email protection, reviewing AI-detected threats, configuring policies, and reducing phishing exposure across the organization.
Implemented and maintained Microsoft 365 security controls including conditional access policies, MFA enforcement, and identity governance via Azure AD.
Collaborated within a two-person IT team to support seven offices across North America and remote users in Europe — including all security tooling and incident response.
Led migration from G Suite to Microsoft 365, including security baseline configuration and user access provisioning for a 130% growth in headcount.
Developed automated onboarding/offboarding processes using PowerShell and Power Automate, reducing access provisioning errors and enforcing least-privilege principles.

experience.title: System Administrator
responsibilities: Sole IT staff responsible for supporting 60 users across five offices in Alberta after the part-time manager's departure.
Worked with limited budget to implement industry standards and ensure efficient IT operations.

experience.title: IT Support Technician
responsibilities: Provided technical support in a multinational company, collaborating daily with the international service desk.
Participated in vendor conferences across Europe, aligning Danish IT deployments with global standards.
Implemented and maintained data connections for mobile devices and laptops using DirectAccess VPN.
